C0033.title: Jiangsu Nantong Sentencing for Sniping and Rush-Purchase Software Development
C0033.summary: From September 2017 to October 2018, Wang developed the “HiRoot” software to automate Taobao flash-sale purchases and sold it through QQ groups and other channels for profit. Procuratorial case material and media reports cite the case as an example of judicial treatment of flash-sale sniping software, finding that such conduct can involve criminal risks related to providing programs or tools for intrusion into or illegal control of computer information systems. The case also shows that automation tools for popular-product flash sales can disrupt fair transaction order and amplify platform-security risks even when they do not directly steal user accounts.
